terms.attributes-alike: all seven attributes at one total, on both sides of every knee (99 to 511), with every weight on
terms.attributes-rotated: the seven attributes at different totals, so that each of them stands at every knee in turn
terms.knee-100: totals of 99, 100 and 101: the first band of WIS and INT (mana) and of the END average
terms.knee-200: totals of 199, 200 and 201: the second band of WIS and INT (mana)
terms.knee-201: totals of 200, 201 and 202: the second band of the END average (352.5 at 201)
terms.knee-255: totals of 254, 255 and 256: the stat knee (STA for HP, DEX past a tenth); the WIS and INT curve does not bend there
terms.knee-510: totals of 509, 510 and 511: the cap of every stat, and of each stat in the END average
terms.end: the END average of STR, STA, DEX and AGI (each counted to 510), beside 100 and 201, between whole numbers, below 0
terms.mixed-mana: WIS and INT pools together: which two pools count flips with the stats, and a tie keeps the trio's order
terms.mana-wis-curve: two WIS pools (Cleric and Shaman) at WIS 200, 255, 270, 280 and 510: the curve runs at one slope from 200 to 510 (the in-game reading behind mana.wis_bands)
terms.mana-none: a trio with no mana class has no mana, whatever its items give
terms.bands-default: a profile with no bands of its own reads the rule's bands for WIS and INT
terms.bands-custom: a profile with bands of its own (three breaks, four slopes)
terms.pool-order: HP and END pools that cross and tie: the two largest count, a tie in the order of the trio
terms.softcap: the sheet armor class with no shield, below, at and above the softcap, for each rate past it
terms.softcap-shield: the same with a shield in the off hand: it adds to X and to the softcap
terms.shield-not-offhand: a shield in an Any place and a plain item in the off hand are worn armor class, not the shield
terms.monk: the Monk bonus beside every bin edge (whole stones of worn weight), on top and inside, and past the table
terms.iksar: the racial armor class on top of the cap and inside X, with and without a Monk
terms.haste: spell haste and the best worn haste against the cap: the worn haste counts what room is left
terms.regen: gear regen up to its cap, buff regen outside it
terms.resists: gear and buff resists up to the cap, a school's own weight against the general one
terms.weapons: weapon damage by setup and hand: a listed bonus, none and 0, one hander and two hander, haste assumed
terms.buffs: buffs chosen among the optional ones: none, one, the best haste of several, a duplicate, an always-on id
terms.decimals: profile numbers that are not whole: decimals, a pool number that only p/q can write
terms.limits: the largest numbers held exactly: 22 items at 2^40 in every stat, weights up to 2^53 - 1, a weight in exponent notation
terms.natural-durability: the HP pools of a profile with Natural Durability at ranks 0 to 4 (0, 2, 5, 10 and 12 percent of the HP from STA), STA below, at and past the knee and the cap, with flat item HP that the AA does not scale
